title: Elizondo on aliens storing messages in genetics

tellings.quote: he said something really interesting if you were going to make something truly enduring truly enduring there's really only two ways to do it you either put something out and deep space where the chances are of it coming into contact with something or minimal or biology genetics

plain: The idea is that anyone wanting to leave a message that truly lasts has only two choices: send it into deep space, where it will rarely meet anyone, or write it into biology and genetics. Jesse Michels passes this on as something a former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo told him. If it were true, the message might already be inside living things on Earth.
